title: MV trying to make an attack have a chance to increase state infliction (anyone got any ideas?)

posts.author: KastoMaria77
posts.body: for synergy reasons i was to make a skill that does the attacking but has a chance (not gurranteed) but a chance to extend the duration of a state infliction that an enemy has, let's say for example an enemy is inflicted with poison you pop out an attack that has a 50% chance to extend the duration once the attack lands how do i achieve that?

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
sanemorality said:
let's say for example an enemy is inflicted with poison you pop out an attack that has a 50% chance to extend the duration once the attack lands how do i achieve that?
Click to expand...
youre already using yanfly's buffs & states and the skill core, so pick a skill tag, use this, and replace the "x"s
Code:
if (Math.random() <.5)
  target.setStateTurns(x, target.stateTurns(x)+1);
